content:
tariq: quick flag - onboarding a new mistralx-lite conversion from llama-3b (fp16 -> int4 via bnb exporter) and saw a reproducible quality blip on inputs with combining acute/tilde marks. sequence below.

sana: which exporter + bnb version? we recently rolled 0.41 that changed quant packing order.

tariq: bitsandbytes 0.41.2, exporter=redwood/gguf-exporter v0.7. used scripts/onboard/convert_bnb.py with pack_order=packed.

leo: paste short repro sample pls.

tariq: sample: "cafe01 and nino03 are tasty"  (contains U+0301 acute, U+0303 tilde combining marks)

fp16 token ids: [44,102,5512,3001,77]
int4 token ids: [44,102,5512,3001,77]  (ids match)

but logits diff for token index 3 (the combining sequence) is ~0.004 relative logit, which changes greedy decode for a small fraction of seeds.

sana: tokens line up so not a tokenizer mapping problem. Have we inspected rotary angle quantization? small differences in angle rounding can flip the top token in tight cases.

leo: can you dump rotary angles for head 4, dim slice 0:8 for fp16 vs int4? hex preferred.

tariq: paste: \n```\nfp16 head4 angles[0:8]: [0x3fe6a2b0,0x3fd234a0,0x3fcf11aa,0x3fb12c00,0x3f9f9000,0x3f880000,0x3f700000,0x3f5a0000]\nint4 head4 angles[0:8]: [0x3fe6a2a8,0x3fd23480,0x3fcf1180,0x3fb12b80,0x3f9f8f80,0x3f87ff80,0x3f6ffff0,0x3f59fff0]\n```\nnotice low-bit truncation and a repeated pattern consistent with packed quant rounding.

sana: yep looks like packer truncation. separate issue: exporter introduced an embed_proj transpose flag defaulting to True which our runtime assumed False; that can also reorder matmul results and amplify small rotary errors. did converter flip embed_proj?

tariq: converter had transpose=True for this run. runtime uses transpose=False by default. that mismatch explains amplification. when I force runtime transpose=True the int4 logits align much closer (~1e-5).

leo: actionables: 
1) add converter->runtime header handshake that asserts embed_proj.transpose matches (sana)
2) add a tiny numeric probe in onboarding: run 64-sample combining-mark probe set and assert top-1 stability between fp16 and int4 within epsilon 1e-3 (tariq)
3) bisect bnb packer rounding and try alternate pack_order (leo)

infra-bot: artifact uploaded: gs://redwood-models/onboard/1769/mistralx-lite-llama3b-bnb.tgz. CI: https://ci.redwood.dev/logs/onboard-1769

tariq: opened small PR with probe + header-check: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/2230. includes tests/onboard/probes/combining_marks_probe.json and converter check that fails noisily on header mismatch.

sana: for short-term block, mark this conversion as "needs-rotary-review" in the dashboard if probe fails. also recommend routing high-combining-mark workloads to fp16 fallback route.

leo: I'll run packer bisect. early hint: switching pack_order to unpacked reduces low-bit truncation but increases size slightly. need perf tradeoff review.

infra-bot: CI for PR #2230 queued: 6 jobs.

tariq: thanks all. will wait for packer bisect and then update the conversion pipeline to emit header flags. coffee. :coffee:
